The following chart shows the features we currently support for each {{glossary.user interface (UI)}}. {{snippet.EV_Table_SupportedEachUI}} ## UI Experience Field Setup {{snippet.EV_UIExperienceSetup}} ## Using the Simple UI After the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} field has been added to your page layout, enabling the Simple UI is simple! 1. This {{variable.Object_Event}} must be a FREE {{variable.Object_Event}}. Paid {{variable.Object_Event}}s are not supported. 2. Make sure there is only one Event Item on the {{variable.Object_Event}}. If there are multiple {{variable.Object_Event}}s, an error will flag. 3. Click the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} dropdown, and select "Simple". 4. Click the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}}, and check out the Simple UI! ![Simple UI](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Simple%20UI.png){height="" width=""}
